label: Does an impersonal source explain the actual selection or only a permitted range?
summary: See docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md sections 59-64 (#2145 Lane 2). Verified results: 54e1279c (choice-cell determination laws: an invariant explanans explains exactly the realized range; selecting a contingent outcome requires a contingent explanans level that no invariant level sees to; the standard is label-independent; the #1953 decomposition), f66e83d4 (matched four-account table: necessary manifestation, invariant D-range source, permissive source, exercise account), 72c06088 (three omission scopes of giving strictly ordered; a necessarily productive source keeps individual and replacement omission, never total refraining; the section 56 replacement table certified with ActualAbsenceByWithholding; STIT controls pointwiseNotJoint and tiedNoEmptyChoice registered), cdde5406 (the #1953 complete-decision fork with Mathlib Maximal: an undominated-decision policy with a creation above omission never omits, yet can omit each creation), adb23c1c (0050b6ed from its total-refraining sibling a8dedf3f, Euclidean access 62b4a40a and monotone powers 6fdd3f60), 44e8200e (0050b6ed strictly weaker than total refraining, compatible with necessary production; Euclidean access and monotonicity each needed). Verdict at the selection step: parity under the determination standard. Decision: 0050b6ed needs only the replacement scope.
blocker: Not blocked for the assigned formal questions. The determination standard cannot separate rational adoption from a matched actualization or generative exercise. A discriminating test needs another explanandum: pro tanto favouring by apprehended content (connects to the Investigation 2 finite-measure test), a warranted permission boundary that makes omission undominated, or the #1380 supervenience obligation of a knowing invariant source.

current_assessment.scope: Range versus actual selection under one determination standard; omission scope of the GOD_4 joint-absence power
current_assessment.assessment: Parity at the selection step: every nonnecessitating account, personal or impersonal, explains the range by its invariant level and the actual selection only by a contingent exercise that nothing invariant determines; necessary manifestation alone selects invariantly, at the price of contingency. 0050b6ed needs only the replacement scope; it does not distinguish an optional creator from a necessarily productive source, and the will route's discrimination lies in its other premises.
current_assessment.next_test: Test pro tanto favouring by apprehended content (Investigation 2 finite-measure test) and a warranted permission boundary that makes omission undominated.
current_assessment.evidence: Proposed assessment in draft PR-2154. The six results passed the focused Lean build, binding check, Comparator and NanoDa. Independent semantic challenge is pending.
current_assessment.supersedes: None. It specifies the selection and omission-scope comparison of sections 39, 56 and 57 without revising their overall judgments.
